rules: Universe: only strong_buy / buy names from the latest screen.
Timing filter: names with timing_signal=wait are excluded from new buys.
Ranking: highest conviction_score first, keep at most 120 names.
Sizing: equal-weight sleeves of current NAV after exits; buys limited by remaining cash.
Hold buffer: full exit only after 2 consecutive rebalance(s) outside the target set.
Re-entry cooldown: wait 1 rebalance(s) after a full exit before buying the same name again.
Dust guard: skip trim/top-up adjustments below £10.

entry_dca_overlay_review.note: Counterfactual only — paper books still fill lump-sum (or graduated starter size). Compare across tracks before treating a cadence as model-independent.

framework.purpose: Observe-only dual-path sleeve lab: widest earliest/latest markers with capital_status tags (on_book / off_book / never_funded). NAV vs ^FTSE stays on the capital book; sleeve metrics stratify by tag.

recording.earliest_entry: First pass on near-buy (hold + conviction >= pre_buy floor 0.28) or buy-tier — whichever comes first
recording.latest_exit: Momentum-grace end + post_grace_extra_days (~1 month); fallback if grace never arms: leave wide zone × exit_confirm_screens + post_grace_extra_days; or hard avoid
recording.best_policy: Nested counterfactual inside the wide episode — not the freeze gate

capital_status.on_book: Crossed threshold and currently (or once) held in the paper fund
capital_status.off_book: Capital sold while the experimental episode was still open
capital_status.never_funded: Crossed threshold but never received paper capital

framework.evidence_validity: Additive observe store — does not invalidate prior NAV / decision-review / exit_shadow marks. Those remain valid for what they measured. Do not back-label historical NAV as dual-path sleeve evidence.

readiness.note: Probability / nested counterfactual promotion waits until each capital_status tag has a thick closed cohort.

sleeve_episodes_review.note: Observe-only — does not change paper capital allocation. Stratify sleeve returns by capital_status; do not mix into NAV vs ^FTSE.

llm_agree_veto_shadow.learning_question: When the algo proposes sell/hold/rebuy, would an evidence-citing agree/veto disagree often enough to justify a later hard veto on the live capital path?
llm_agree_veto_shadow.principle: Any LLM influence on a live capital/decision path must record durable justifying evidence in the decision trail; no silent LLM discretion. This shadow is observe-only (influences_live=false) until a promotion gate.
llm_agree_veto_shadow.note: Observe-only agree/veto shadow — never blocks fills. still_in_buy_set remains the algo capital-path twin; this is a parallel review layer. Cards carry judge_spec_id for later A/B. Phase-1 LLM judge active (llm.v1, parent heuristic.v1); heuristic baseline retained in card.meta.heuristic_baseline.
